name: huntress-mcp
description: Every Huntress endpoint, plus fleet-wide incident, coverage, and billing rollups the API can't.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

huntress_api_key.title: HUNTRESS_API_KEY
huntress_api_key.description: Sets HUNTRESS_API_KEY for the Huntress MCP server. Get a credential from https://www.huntress.com/terms-of-service.

huntress_api_secret.title: HUNTRESS_API_SECRET
huntress_api_secret.description: Sets HUNTRESS_API_SECRET for the Huntress MCP server. Get a credential from https://www.huntress.com/terms-of-service.

huntress_base_url.title: Huntress API base URL
huntress_base_url.description: Base URL for the Huntress API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

huntress_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
huntress_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Huntress requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

huntress_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
huntress_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
